name: Guinea-Bissau

flag.description: A vertical red band at the hoist bearing a black five-pointed star, with two horizontal bands, yellow over green, filling the fly.
flag.symbolism: Red represents the blood of the independence fighters, yellow the sun and wealth, and green hope and the forests; the black star stands for African unity.

hook: Guinea-Bissau has a black star on a red hoist band beside yellow over green; Benin has the same layout but a plain green band.
trivia: Guinea-Bissau declared independence from Portugal in 1973; Portugal recognised it in 1974.
Hippos in the Bijagós archipelago are known for swimming in the sea between islands.
